tagline: Leasing, operating, managing, and remarketing long-lived, widely used assets, primarily in the rail market
hero_kpi_rationale: The primary segment representing approximately 51% of total profit in 2025, a key driver of overall company performance despite a slight annual decline.

kpis.name: Rail North America Segment Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by the company's primary segment, which manages railcars in North America.
kpis.description: Profit declined slightly in 2025 due to higher maintenance and interest expenses, despite an increase in leasing revenues.

kpis.name: Total Segment Profit
kpis.explanation: Sum of profits from the company's various operating segments.
kpis.description: Growth is driven by Rail International and Engine Leasing, which offset the decline in North America.
kpis.signal: Strong growth supported by international operations and engine leasing

kpis.name: Net Income Attributable to GATX
kpis.explanation: Net income after taxes and non-controlling interests, available to shareholders.
kpis.description: Net income increased due to improved performance in international and engine leasing segments.
kpis.signal: Net income growth outpacing revenue growth

kpis.name: Total Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by all segments of the company.
kpis.description: Revenues increased due to higher lease rates and the acquisition of new assets.

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by shareholders' equity, a measure of performance for shareholders.
kpis.description: Return on equity improved due to efficient asset management and earnings growth.

kpis.name: Investment Volume
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in new assets or acquisitions during the year.
kpis.description: Investment volume decreased compared to 2024, prior to the Wells Fargo Rail acquisition completed in January 2026.

kpis.name: Rail International Segment Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by rail operations in Europe and India.
kpis.description: The international segment grew due to higher leasing revenues and favorable foreign exchange effects.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by expansion in Europe and India

kpis.name: Engine Leasing Segment Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from aircraft engine leasing through RRPF and GEL.
kpis.description: Strong recovery in air traffic and delivery delays for new engines are driving demand for used engines.
kpis.signal: Surge in demand for existing aircraft engines

risks.title: Customer demand dependence and economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned early (page 13) and repeated multiple times, emphasizing the importance of customer demand for transportation assets. The language intensity is high, describing potentially materially adverse impacts. The global economic environment is a key factor.

risks.title: Risks related to the integration of the Wells Fargo Rail acquisition
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed across several paragraphs (pages 14-15) and relates to a major acquisition. The language is strong (numerous risks and uncertainties, beyond our control). Successful integration is critical for future results.

risks.title: Increased competition and competitors' financial resources
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified (page 13) and highlights the size and superior financial resources of certain competitors. The potential impact on profitability and asset utilization is emphasized.

risks.title: Impact of trade policies and customs tariffs
risks.score_rationale: This risk is specifically addressed (page 13) with mention of current uncertainty regarding international trade relations. The impact on costs and customer demand is considered potentially significant.

risks.title: Rising maintenance costs and repair constraints
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed (page 14) and concerns both contract renewals and maintenance events. The potential increase in costs and impact on operations are clearly stated.

risks.title: Risks related to long-term railcar purchase commitments
risks.score_rationale: This risk is well explained (page 14) and concerns long-term financial commitments for purchasing new railcars. The potential difficulty of leasing these railcars at profitable rates in the event of an economic slowdown is a key point.

risks.title: Dependence on North American railroad operations
risks.score_rationale: This risk is specifically mentioned (page 13) and concerns the sensitivity of demand to changes in North American railroad operations.

ai_positioning.summary: GATX does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial, acquisition, and operational aspects of the company without reference to AI.
